inputs.name: hand over from Logging and Observability to Model Performance Monitoring

output.level_0: Logs crash unpredictably, so nobody sees model drift until customers complain loudly.
output.level_1: No connection exists between logging and monitoring, leaving performance blind spots unaddressed.
output.level_2: Engineers manually copy log excerpts into monitoring dashboards weekly to spot degradation.
output.level_3: Logs stream directly into the monitoring pipeline, triggering alerts on performance shifts.
output.level_4: Governed data contracts ensure log formats match monitoring requirements for compliance audits.
